name: Ryan Fecteau
bio: Speaker of the Maine House of Representatives. Sponsor of LD 1, the storm-resilience package signed into law in 2025.

name: Mattie Daughtry
bio: President of the Maine Senate, representing Senate District 23 (Brunswick, Freeport, Harpswell, Pownal and part of Yarmouth).

name: Billy Bob Faulkingham
bio: House Republican Leader and commercial lobsterman representing Downeast coastal communities.

name: Amy Kuhn
bio: Represents Falmouth and part of Cumberland. Lead sponsor of Maine's online data privacy and AI-transparency legislation.

name: Melanie Sachs
bio: Represents Freeport and Pownal. Sponsor of LD 307, the first-in-the-nation data center moratorium bill.

name: Tiffany Roberts-Lovell
bio: Represents South Berwick and part of North Berwick. Sponsor of automotive right-to-repair implementation legislation.

name: Deqa Dhalac
bio: Represents part of South Portland. Sponsor of LD 1971 on state and local roles in federal immigration enforcement.

name: Matthew Beck
bio: Represents part of South Portland. Sponsor of LD 1109 on large-capacity ammunition feeding devices.

name: Anne Carney
bio: Represents Cape Elizabeth, South Portland and part of Scarborough. Senate chair of the Judiciary Committee.

name: Trey Stewart
bio: Senate Republican Leader representing Aroostook County communities.
